documents.content: A callback FAILED with actual receiver HTTP 503 is a transport failure. ACKNOWLEDGED with HTTP 202 means only accepted into the receiver queue. Verify the same event receiver processing state; QUEUED is not PROCESSED. Never resend automatically.

args.reason: 先按用户要求获取版本化接入契约，明确 200、回调投递与接收处理的可区分判定标准。
HTTP 200 only proves acceptance; check current order lifecycle to determine whether an async callback is due.

model_traces.assistant_text: I have the lifecycle fact (order COMPLETED at version 1) but the actual callback transport outcome is unknown — that's the gap.

args.reason: Order shows COMPLETED; need the bound callback event's real transport ack/failure to explain "downstream got nothing".
Delivery is ACKNOWLEDGED with HTTP 202, which per contract only means queued; check whether the same event was actually processed downstream.

model_traces.assistant_text:
当前订单事实：async-order v1 为 COMPLETED、HTTP 200；回调事件 event-45fc… v1 为 ACKNOWLEDGED、接收方 HTTP 202；同一事件接收状态为 QUEUED。  
因此订单接口 HTTP 200 只是订单侧响应，接收方 HTTP 202/ACKNOWLEDGED 只表示接受入队，均不等于接收方完成处理。  
固定 Gate 结论为 RECEIVER_PROCESSING_UNCONFIRMED，不能认定下游已完成回调处理。  
这修正了“下游没收到回调”的原始说法：已有回调事件被接收方接受，但处理完成仍未被证实。  
知识/Skill 仅作排查方法，历史 503/重发类建议不适用于本案，且不重发。
